text.name: Tariff Shock
text.rules: Record "tariff wall". Until the end of this turn, points spent by LIO count 1 less, never below 1. SAE chooses: Retaliate? If yes, SAE spends 1 point, then until the end of this turn, points spent by SAE count 1 less, never below 1; if no, at the end of this turn, SAE spends 1 point.
text.history: On 2 April 2025 the U.S. President announced a 10 per cent tariff on imports from almost all countries, effective 5 April, with higher rates for many trading partners announced for 9 April; the rates changed repeatedly in the following months.
